large_corpus.decode_upper_bound: 1000 + separately declared bounded context carryover; prefix validation bytes measured separately

fixed_design_targets.scope: Design thresholds, not measured performance promises or builder CLI budgets.

runner_contract_requirements: Manifest pins candidate binary/source, corpus/generator/runner, OS/compiler/storage and command argv digests; each run result records actual exit and method.
Seeded corpus writer and large ingestion stream bounded data, not giant retained payload arrays; no private source or credentials.

Invoke exact candidate with argv list and shell disabled. Finite per-probe timeouts, bounded capture/output and resource sampler lifetime; nonzero exit/timeout/schema mismatch forbids performance success.
Actual elapsed measurements use monotonic clock; distinguish warm queries, cold setup/migration and replay. Store raw samples and report spread, not invented aggregate values.

Resource metric must identify OS/source/process scope and reliable peak versus sampled maximum. Sampling must not be labeled true peak. Unavailable required measurement is blocked/unmeasured, not zero/pass.

Windows native and Linux native candidate proof independently required; WSL/crosscompiled binary is not native Windows. Actual pinned old binary failure is not_measurable_preport, never a synthetic baseline.

Historical comparison only when cohort, command/work, units, host/runtime/corpus and method are comparable; otherwise explicit refused/noncomparable. Fixed new-version absolute budgets remain required.
Decode count and prefix verification IO independently instrumented; do not equate incremental decoding with O(delta) total IO.
No source content/argv payloads in report; only explicit safe benchmark command metadata and synthetic identifiers.
independent_author_must_freeze_before_bu: Corpus seed/version, exact fact distributions, depth interpretation and multi-caller/missing-link denominator without overlap ambiguity
Executable fixture/Answer protocol and candidate commands with independent expected record/count/status outputs; current0.7 command compatibility versus new surface unsupported explicit
Percentile convention and sample population, median/worst definitions, throughput direction/regression formula and zero/invalid cases
Declared bounded carryover maximum and edge-record fixture; effective measurement source for all budgets
Deterministic reproducibility/digest/atomic report validation and meaningful corpus conservation checks independent of generator implementation

broad_draft_candidate_inputs.caution: Broad pack has no runner/corpus seeds or executed baseline and is unaccepted; these are source candidates only.

authorship_boundary: Independent Grok/other distinct expected-value author and Claude review must freeze runnable expected cases. Codex runner builder cannot author its own expected outputs. This file extracts approved requirements only.
